_about: "Why is that a problem?" texts for the website's team page (sponsor.why), for sponsors rated serious or severe that the seed doesn't cover. Written on 2026-09-25 only from the claims each one cites; those claims must be about an owner in the sponsor's chain (the website validator checks it). Drafts: a person reviews them before status becomes 'reviewed'. build_normalized.py merges them; a why already on the sponsor (the seed's) wins.

why.text: Etihad is owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi, part of the United Arab Emirates. In 2024, 43 activists and dissidents got life sentences in a single mass trial that rights groups called grossly unfair, and in March 2025 the UAE’s Federal Supreme Court upheld the convictions. Putting Etihad on a famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: In 2024, 43 activists in the UAE got life sentences in one mass trial, and the convictions were upheld in 2025.
